decision: Accept the exact same-record edge set as reviewed
decision_basis: The exact July 2025 MBS v3 qualification binds every service-to-benefit edge to the same source record identity, ordinal, source digest, receipt digest, and source era. Cross-record, forged-digest, and unpermitted-rights negative controls passed. The reviewed assertion is only that the paired rows describe a same-record service-benefit relationship.
limitations: This is a candidate relationship review, not M-110 overall acceptance or product admission.
It does not establish that a benefit is payable, a clinical meaning, therapeutic equivalence, or cross-era equivalence.
It does not establish PBS or terminology relationships, source completeness, patient denominators, or M-112 federation acceptance.
The underlying candidate graph and the earlier consumer canary remain immutable historical evidence with review_state=not_reviewed; this receipt records the subsequent maintainer review disposition.
